input.command:
S=/private/tmp/claude-502/-Users-vitaliy-Documents-GitHub-local-whisper/881e21dc-c26e-4f4f-865e-0d78e8553961/scratchpad
echo "### J: -capture_raw_data true, -t 15 ###"
/usr/local/bin/ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -f avfoundation -capture_raw_data true -i :default -ac 1 -ar 16000 -t 15 "$S/J.wav" > "$S/J.log" 2>&1
printf "   J samples="; /usr/local/bin/ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 "$S/J.wav" 2>/dev/null || echo "(failed)"
echo "### K: -audio_device_index 0 -t 15 ###"
/usr/local/bin/ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -f avfoundation -audio_device_index 0 -i ":0" -ac 1 -ar 16000 -t 15 "$S/K.wav" > "$S/K.log" 2>&1
printf "   K samples="; /usr/local/bin/ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 "$S/K.wav" 2>/dev/null || echo "(failed)"
echo "### older ffmpeg available? ###"; brew search '/^ffmpeg@/' 2>/dev/null | head; ls -d /usr/local/Cellar/ffmpeg* /opt/homebrew/Cellar/ffmpeg* 2>/dev/null
input.description: Test raw data capture and check for older ffmpeg
